Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in interpreting the data returned by the WebSurfer. The WebSurfer correctly extracted a snippet from Mabumbe stating "Born October 31, 1972, Queens, New York City, U.S." However, the Planner hallucinated that the snippet indicated Jamaica as the birthplace. This is a severe misreading of the visible text, leading to an incorrect final conclusion (Jamaica) instead of the correct one (Queens, New York).
